location_exception_reason: Auditorium tensile structures are custom-engineered projects quoted per site dimensions and load requirements; location is a project parameter (design input), not a buyer decision factor or product attribute. Removing location from title leaves the product complete and meaningful.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Fabricator) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. The product is a tensile structure regardless of whether the seller manufactures, supplies, or installs it—the business relationship does not change what is being sold.
